summary.text: Marcus B. Simon is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 13th District, which covers part of Fairfax County and the city of Falls Church, and has served since 2014.
Simon sits on the House committees on Public Safety, Courts of Justice, General Laws and Rules.

paragraphs.text: Marcus B. Simon was born in Austin, TX, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Simon's education as West Virginia University, WV; New York University, NY (B.A., Near Eastern Studies, 1992); American University Washington College of Law, Washington, DC (J.D., 1999).
The profile gives Simon's occupation as attorney.
The profile lists Simon's military service as USA (CPT, Judge Advocate General's Corps, 2000-03).

Simon's listed memberships and affiliations include Temple Rodef Shalom; Greater McLean Chamber of Commerce; Northern Virginia Association of Realtors; Kent Gardens Recreation Club; Falls Church Chamber of Commerce; Fairfax County Bar Association.
